25WhichstatementaboutthepropertiesofelementsinGroupI or inGroupVIIiscorrect?
A
Bromine displaces iodine from an aqueous solution of potassium iodide.
B
Chlorine, bromine and iodine are diatomic gases at room temperature.
C
Lithium, sodium and potassium are soft non-metals.
D
Lithium, sodium and potassium have an increasing number of electrons in their outer
shells.
